game_abilities.title_en: When struck by Physical Attacks, his Resistance against Physical Attacks goes up by {{var_1}} (Max: 10 Stacks). One stack of Energy Resistance is lost.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 当受到物理攻击时，他对物理攻击的抵抗力会增加{{var_1}}（最多：10层）。一层能量抗性消失。

game_abilities.title_en: When struck by Energy Attacks, his Resistance against Energy Attacks goes up by {{var_2}} (Max: 10 Stacks). One stack of Physical Resistance is lost.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 当受到能量攻击时，他对能量攻击的抵抗力会增加 {{var_2}}（最多：10 层）。失去一层物理抗性。

game_abilities.title_en: Each time Ultra Magnus completes a Light Melee Combo, his Resistance against Physical Attacks goes up by {{var_3}} (Max: 10 Stacks). One stack of Energy Resistance is lost.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 通天晓每次完成轻型近战连击时，他对物理攻击的抵抗力都会提高 {{var_3}}（最多：10 层）。一层能量抗性消失。

game_abilities.title_en: Each time Ultra Magnus completes a Medium Melee Combo, his Resistance against Energy Attacks goes up by {{var_4}} (Max: 10 Stacks). One stack of Physical Resistance is lost.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 每次通天晓完成中型近战连击时，他对能量攻击的抵抗力就会增加 {{var_4}}（最多：10 层）。失去一层物理抗性。

game_abilities.title_en: Ranged Attacks: {{var_5}} chance to Nullify an Attack or Melee Buff.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 远程攻击：{{var_5}} 几率无效攻击或近战增益。

game_abilities.title_en: Heavy Attacks: {{var_6}} chance to inflict Burn, dealing Heat damage for {{var_7}} Attack over <s>6</s> {{var_8}}.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 重击：{{var_6}} 几率造成燃烧，对 {{var_7}} 攻击造成热伤害，超过 <s>6</s> {{var_8}}。

game_abilities.title_en: Special Attacks: Ultra Magnus crushes opponents with his hammer, converting Armor Buffs into Armor Breaks, each applying {{var_9}} Armor reduction for {{var_10}}.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 特殊技：通天晓用他的锤子粉碎对手，将装甲增益转化为装甲破坏，每次都会对 {{var_10}} 施加 {{var_9}} 装甲减少。
